[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Gorgi''' was the commanding officer of the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']].<ref name="Godking" /> He was loyal to his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and believed that anyone threatening his vessel was a clear enemy. A small man with thinning [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Gorgi was know to indulge in [[Smoking/Legends|smoking]] a [[Pipe/Legends|pipe]] when off-duty.<ref name="Godking-CC">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Classic Campaigns}}</ref>
